answer.summary: 10 deterministic failures in 3 test classes, none flaky. InjectRelationLinkTenantTest fails the write-attribution guard because tags and asset_groups are written under tenant OTHER (AssetGroupService.createAssetGroup, TagLinkJdbc.saveTag). ExerciseChildrenApiTest gets 404 where 200 is expected and a 'Log title|true|false' mismatch. The same tenant-scoping failure repeats in all runs, so a rerun will likely fail again. The log doesn't show which commit caused it, and the failing test files aren't in the change, so verify the tenant-scoping path before rerunning. The NoHttpResponseException retries are dependency-download noise and didn't cause these failures.
